newsitem.title: UK: Brit Assurance to offer 902 mln stg.
newsitem.headline: Brit Assurance to offer 902 mln stg.

text.p: Britain's Britannic Assurance Plc said on Tuesday that it had identified 902 million stg of assets as wholly attributable to shareholders.
The groups said at the end of 1995 the total assets in the life funds were 5.682 billion stg.
Out of the total assets, 4.70 billion stg is attributable to the profit funds while another 79 million stg to non-profit funds.
Britannic also declared a special bonus of 209 million stg. Details of this bonus would be announced with the 1996 bonus to be declared next month.
"Following the allocation of the special bonus, Britannic's profit funds will remain amongst the strongest in the industry," it said in a statement.
